name: Potato Starch
siboNotes: Pure potato starch is well-tolerated for SIBO as it contains no FODMAPs and can help thicken foods without adding fermentable sugars.
preparationTips: Mix with cold liquid first to prevent lumping when adding to hot dishes
Use as a gluten-free thickener for soups, sauces, and gravies
Store in airtight container in cool, dry place to prevent moisture absorption
Can be used in baking as partial flour substitute for gluten-free recipes
pairsWellWith: Chicken or vegetable broth for thickening
nutritionalHighlights: Pure carbohydrate with minimal protein or fat
Resistant starch when cooled may support gut health
No vitamins or minerals - primarily functional ingredient
